rules_and_exceptions.statement: Use Bosch Sans as the primary font family for all font levels, from headlines to body text.
In the Digital Design System, Bosch Sans is available in Regular and Bold font styles.
Default digital type settings are Bosch Sans, normal style, regular 400 weight, M / 1rem size, no text decoration, and 1.5 line height.
From XL and larger, the line height is reduced.
1rem usually corresponds to 16px / dp / pt, but product user interfaces may require individually defined sizes because virtual pixels do not automatically correspond to physical screen pixels.
Exceptions may use Bosch Sans Italic for quotations within paragraphs and a monospaced font for code snippets.
When deviating because of hardware influences or legal regulations, the project is responsible for compliance with official regulations, including accessibility rules.

sections_raw_structured.title: Overview
paragraphs: In the Digital Design System, Bosch Sans is available in Regular and Bold font styles. Bosch Sans is used in all font levels, from headlines to body text. The fine gradations of the font ensure easy-to-read texts in all font sizes.
Detailed information on Bosch Sans and the font families for download can be found in the Bosch Brand Guide: Bosch Sans at Bosch Brand Guide

sections_raw_structured.title: Digital typography
paragraphs: The following properties are currently defined in the DDS for the digital use of type. The default definition (highlighted in bold below) is based on accessibility standards for digital interfaces.
Info! 1rem usually corresponds to 16px / dp / pt.

This does not apply to product user interfaces, since the sizes for the respective display must be defined individually. Px / dp / pt are virtual pixels and do not automatically correspond to the physical pixels on screens.
Exceptions and deviations
Certain use cases require a break from the standard rules. For example, it is permissible to use Bosch Sans Italic for quotations within paragraphs, a monospaced font for displaying code snippets.
Furthermore, influences of hardware and legal regulations may require deviations from the standards defined here.
In case of any deviations, the respective project is responsible for complying with the corresponding official regulations (e.g. accessibility rules).

sections_raw_structured.title: Font styles and semantics
paragraphs: Font styles are detached from function and semantics. Therefore, there are no explicit instructions that, for example, a 1st order headline must always have a certain size. For example, a 1st order headline can have the style "Text 4XL Bold" or "Text L Regular", this decision must be made in each project. The technically semantically correct order does not always correspond to the intended visual hierarchy of a page.
Info! If no other styles are set, these standards apply like the following. Deviations are permitted if they are accessible and conform to the Bosch brand identity.

sections_raw_structured.title: Icons and typography
paragraphs: Icons that appear in combination with text or whose sizes should be harmoniously adapted to the typography are calculated according to a special formula. This makes it possible for icons to resize proportionally and correctly as font sizes vary. Icons may be placed to the right or left of the text.
The icon formula:
Formula icon size: font-size * line-height = icon-size
icon-line-height = 1
Formula icon–label distance: (font-size * line-height)/3 = icon-distance
